title: Smart & Simple
body:
I have retired any desire to work with any other "office" apps besides the Google suite. Apple iWork is weighted down with it's beautification options - which was the initial appeal over Windows' Office which is ghastly and difficult to work with.

Google Sheets is elemental, clear, fully format-able and lacks nothing that you actually didn't need. 

My only reservation for that last star is I find the iPhone / iPad app a little less usable than the desktop version. Which is totally understandable and I have learnt to build my documents with the limitations in mind so I don't run into problems when I want to edit them on the go. 

I love the templates they offer and actually want to find an excuse to use all of them - even though I'm s designer and shouldn't really find any joy in using an accounting / formula driven app. Current favorite template is the "To Do" lists which I generate and share with all my clients - I change the date format to "year-month-date" and add "task manager" and "due date" and it seriously helps keep everyone in the loop and on track without additional slack-like apps.
